text: You breathe out about a pound and a half of carbon dioxide a day.
Now multiply that by everyone on Earth.
Scientists just did. Two billion tons a year. Just from staying alive.
And it jumped seventy-four percent since 1985.
But it's not because we breathe harder. There are just way more of us.
So... is your breathing heating the planet? Nope.
That carbon came from your food. Plants pulled it from the air months ago. It's a loop.
But burning oil is different. That carbon was buried for millions of years.
So why count your breath at all? Because climate math has to add up every source. Even you.
So go ahead. Take a deep breath... and let it out.
